caseNameFull: Investment Company Institute v. Camp, Comptroller of the Currency

opinions.text:
C. A. D. C. Cir. [Certiorari granted, 397 U. S. 986.] '• Motion of the Solicitor General for additional time for oral argument granted and 15 minutes allotted for that purpose. An additional 15 minutes allotted to counsel for petitioner.

The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
